title: Coherence from diagonal and universal triple tests
statement: For a category C, a Cat-valued pseudofunctor F on Cᵒᵖ, and a family f_a:X_a→S, let T be natural overlap transitions [def-pc-local-overlap-transitions]. Choose pairwise pullbacks sq_ab of f_a and f_b and compatible threefold pullbacks sq₃_abc. If T has identity on each chart tested with its two identity maps and its composition equation on each chosen threefold pullback with the universal projections, then T is coherent on every test object. There are no scheme, finite presentation, directed limit or comparison hypotheses.

source.place: Tag 01ZR, first proof (Zariski gluing), and clause (3); https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01ZR

proof.text: Pull the chart diagonal identity along an arbitrary map into that chart. Naturality identifies the pulled transition with its given transition. Pullback preserves identity, and the pseudofunctor comparison isomorphisms cancel.

The threefold pullback universal property gives a simultaneous lift of any three maps having the same composite to S. Pull the tested composition equation along that lift. Naturality identifies all three maps; pullback preserves their composition after cancellation of the comparison isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01ZR first proof: extend universal chart equations to all test objects using ChosenPullback₃.exists_lift and pullHom_hom

lean.statement: theorem coherent_of_universal_tests {C : Type*} [Category C] {F : Pseudofunctor (LocallyDiscrete Cᵒᵖ) Cat} {ι : Type*} {S : C} {X : ι → C} {f : ∀ a, X a ⟶ S} (T : F.OverlapTransitions f) (sq : ∀ a b, Limits.ChosenPullback (f a) (f b)) (sq₃ : ∀ a b c, Limits.ChosenPullback₃ (sq a b) (sq b c) (sq a c)) (hself : ∀ a, T.hom (f a) (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (Category.id_comp _) (Category.id_comp _) = 𝟙 _) (hcomp : ∀ a b c, T.hom (sq₃ a b c).p (sq₃ a b c).p₁ (sq₃ a b c).p₂ (sq₃ a b c).w₁ (sq₃ a b c).w₂ ≫ T.hom (sq₃ a b c).p (sq₃ a b c).p₂ (sq₃ a b c).p₃ (sq₃ a b c).w₂ (sq₃ a b c).w₃ = T.hom (sq₃ a b c).p (sq₃ a b c).p₁ (sq₃ a b c).p₃ (sq₃ a b c).w₁ (sq₃ a b c).w₃) : T.Coherent
